item.title: iPscDB data for download
item.description:
PengLu
iPscDB is an integrated platform for plant single-cell transcriptomic data integration and analysis, combining 4,688,428 cells and 288,139 curated cell markers from 946 experiments across 38 plant species. Datasets with available raw data were reprocessed through a uniform pipeline, with integration quality and automated annotation quantitatively benchmarked. A Marker Confidence Level scheme grades each marker by evidence strength and independence. Platform: https://www.tobaccodb.org/ipscdb/home

item.description:
Simon van Lierde
A client-side web app and TypeScript library for drafting CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) contribution statements for scholarly publications, with a contribution heatmap and JATS4R XML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown exports for journal submission systems.
